sloka: गवयेन गवाक्षेण शरभेण गजेन च ।अन्यैश्च हरिभिर्युद्धं मदर्थे त्यक्तजीवितैः ।न चातिक्रमितुं शक्यं दैवं सुग्रीवमानुषैः ।। ६.४९.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: gavayena gavākṣeṇa śarabheṇa gajena ca ।anyaiśca haribhiryuddhaṁ madarthe tyaktajīvitaiḥ ।na cātikramituṁ śakyaṁ daivaṁ sugrīvamānuṣaiḥ ।। 6.49.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva! It is not possible for human beings to overcome God (destiny). O scorcher of enemies! Sugriva, my best friend, you have all done righteously that which is not possible."
